name: payment-gateway
description: Collects customer payments over mobile money and card in Kenya and Nigeria, and disburses net settlement payouts to merchants' payout accounts. No provider has been chosen yet — the PRD leaves this an open capability.

suggestions.name: Flutterwave
suggestions.description: Pan-African aggregator covering mobile money and card collections plus payouts in both Kenya and Nigeria.

suggestions.name: Paystack
suggestions.description: Strong Nigeria card/bank coverage with mobile money and payouts across supported African markets.

suggestions.name: Cellulant (Tingg)
suggestions.description: Africa-focused mobile money aggregation, strong in East Africa including Kenya.

suggestions.name: DPO Pay
suggestions.description: Pan-African payment processor with card and mobile money collections and merchant payouts.
